about.bio:
Hi!! I am Samarth, a developer passionate about building software, games, and hardware. I love everything tech! When I am not coding or tinkering with electronics, I enjoy editing videos and exploring new technologies.

I'm always happy to talk about computers and programming. Welcome to my portfolio!

highlights.text: Reviewed and provided feedback on over 1300 technical projects submitted by teens worldwide for Summer of Making, an event by Hack Club and GitHub.
Hosted the SOM game jam for a community of 18k+ high schoolers around the globe!
Organised Borked (site), a game Web Jam for 6.7k teens! High Schoolers had to build a website with the worst UI possible!

resume.introduction: I build open-source software, games, and hardware- from custom cameras and devboards to web platforms. My work spans full-stack development, game development, and hardware prototyping, with projects used by thousands of people across the Hack Club and Rune communities.

experience.title: Hack Club - Special Activities Division
bullets: Helped organize Summer of Making, a coding and hardware hackathon by Hack Club and GitHub, with 25,000+ teen participants worldwide making real technical projects.
Built an open-source submission and peer-voting platform, and hosted the Summer of Making game jam, serving 18,000+ teens. Also organized Borked, a web-development challenge for 6,700+ teens.

experience.title: Tester Work - QA Tester & Content Writer
bullets: Tested apps for companies including Facebook (Meta), Matterport, and Deezer.
Wrote 4 software-testing articles for the company blog, reaching 50,000+ views.

experience.title: Reflectoring.io — Technical Content Writer
bullets: Authored an article on TypeScript that reached 100,000+ views.

experience.title: Benchmark School System — Secretary, Media & Marketing
bullets: Managed the MarkMUN 2023 Instagram account and grew its view rate past 1,000.
Led the Media team, and managed video editing and footage processing for MarkMUN '23 and produced the school end-of-year recap video.

recognition: Won multiple international hackathons, including 1st place in the High Seas Game Development Hackathon and 2nd place in Arcade Game Jam.

Had two projects featured in the Hack Club 2025 magazine, reaching 13,000+ readers, and many indie game developers and prominent tech influencers; distributed at Open Sauce, and at GitHub HQ during Campfire Flagship.
Invited to fully sponsored week-long hackathons in Shanghai (2025) and Singapore (2026).
Earned gold medals in IKLC, ICATS Science Contest, and IBIC; qualified for the Hippo English Olympiad regional round held in Turkey.
